content: « Atɔŋ abaal anà bàtaa, làwem un'lɔn in'kwen mɛ musà kusà a bɛ apanà. »
Mpal bàwem ba Pɔl wàmutɛn u ndaa a Bɛbɛlyɔ, Ba bàkäl akul. Apan Pɔl waa kàtɛn naa:

« Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'yudà, mɛ ban'bör u Tarsis a Silisi, wɛɛ mɛ ban'bɔŋ u bul alà, ban'lɔŋ kà in'kɔl a Ngamalyɛl asànaa awà un'kɔɔn a andweer, mɛ kàkäl anà un'kanà mbɔɔn ntɔn Nzam asànaa naa làbà bɛ banswà ŋàbawà.
Mɛ awà, mɛ kàyiiŋ Mbwo ayi ngwal tii u nkweel, mɛ kàbäm abaal anà akaar in'siŋ anà katɔɔm u bɔlokà.
Undweer a angaŋ anà itsuŋ a andweer bà ambäl amɛ: mɛ kàwɛl anà in'kaan akà ba ntɔn mukyà Damas mukɔr atɔŋ bàkäl kwo anà mukasyen Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bapɛ ntaaŋàmbar.
Pɔl kan'kyään mbuul a mpem ande
« Yàmɛnà naa kàkäl mɛ u mbwo anà kàtöl mɛ tsütsü a Damas, kà imbürà, mper a midi, un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà mwɛy kàfü du, waa kan'diŋà.
Mɛ kàbü u mɛɛn, umpal kàwem mɛ ndaa mwɛy itɛɛnà a mɛ naa: "Sɔl, Sɔl, ntɔn nkye ayan'mɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ?"
Mɛ kàfuur naa: "Mwol, ngye nà?" Nde kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Yɛsu Nazorye akwà afàmɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ."
Baar bàkäl anà mɛ bàkyàman un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà, wɛɛ ba bàwem anki ndaa a mbuur kàyäämà anà mɛ.
Mɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, ininà mɛ an'kwo mukyer?" Mwol kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Mbarà, kyen Damas, bàkyer akasam yinà yanswà kàmaswaŋ Nzam mukyer."
Wɛɛ un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà awun kan'dwä mii, baar bàkäl anà mɛ ban'ntɛ mpi u kɔɔ tii kàtöl mɛ Damas.
« U Damas, kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas, nde kàkäl anà inzaam anà kàläbà un'kɔɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Ayudà banswà bàkälà paa bun'tɛɛlà imbäl.
Nde kàkyer ayan'man, waa kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Un'tɔŋ amɛ Sɔl, fàman. Taaŋ nsil alan mɛ waa kàfàman, waa kun'mɛn.
Nde kàtɛn naa: "Nzam a bàtaaràbi kasɔ̈ɔ̈l kaa usà ntɔn muyöb ukwen ande, muman Ŋabalàbal anà muwem ndaa itoo u mun ande,
ntɔn ngye asàkal mbäl ande u mii a baar banswà unsà indiir kàmɛn ngye anà kàwem ngye.
Wɛɛ apanà, ininà ngye afidilà? Mbarà, wal ndüümà anà mpɔɔŋà a man'be angye mutà ikɔb ande din.
Pɔl akà in'seŋ myumwɛy
« Yàmɛnà naa kàfurà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, ilä mwɛy, mɛ kàkäl muyamà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàmɛn imanmii.
Mɛ kàmɛn Mwol, nde kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Kyer agyägyä, too apanà u Yɛlusàlɛm, ntɔn ba imbäl angye ntɔn mɛ bàyàkyey anki."
Wɛɛ mɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, ba ŋakwo bàkyàyöb naa mɛ, mɛ kàyisaa baar u bɔlokà anà kàyikamà baar bàkäl anà làkwikilà akà ngye an'füm uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà yanswà.
Mpal bàdwä mbäl angye Ityen, mɛ ŋakwo kàkäl paa, mukyey baar bun'dwä anà mukaar ipfɛy aba.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Kyen, mɛ, mɛ ŋakwo in'yatɔm ukwɛl mper akà baar mpa abà Ayudà." »
Pɔl anà mfum a aŋità a Lɔmà
Ba bàkäl mukun'weemà tii mpal kàtɛn nde ndaa ayi, ba bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: « Lun'lwom u mɛɛn mbuur atub awà, nde ukwe anki mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈! »
Ba bàkuubà in'kwɛŋ, bàkaamà ipfɛy aba anà bàfuumà un'twà u du.
Mfum a nsaab kàswɛŋ naa bun'biil u fɔrtɛrɛs anà bun'fuul in'lɔɔn a an'füm ntɔn nde uyöb ndaa kàkyer nde ntɔn ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ ntɔn nde.
Wɛɛ mpal bun'bäm ba in'siŋ ntɔn bun'käm an'füm, Pɔl kàtɛn a kaptɛn kàkäl paa naa: « Nkye bɛ làbye anà mbwo mukam un'lɔmà an'füm ukɔɔn un'fuul un'lɔɔn? »
Kaptɛn kàwem nde abwɛy, waa kàkàkyään mfum a nsaab: « Ngye pà akyer aben? Mbuur awà wà un'lɔmà. »
Apan, mfum a nsaab kàyàsin apà Pɔl, waa kun'fuul: « Nkyän, nkye ndandaa ngye awà un'lɔmà? » Nde naa: « Ɛɛ. »
Mfun a nsaab waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ kàfür ngim mbɔɔn ntɔn mubulà un'lɔmà. » Pɔl waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ un'bar anki, ilɔmà amɛ bàkyer an'bɔr anà kya. »
Kà imbürà, baar bàlun'kam an'füm ntɔn nde usi ndaa, waa bàtɛ upay. Wɛɛ mfum a nsaab kàwem bɔɔmà naa kyekà mbuur kàbäm nde in'siŋ wà, wà un'lɔmà.
Pɔl u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl
Lalan taaŋtyà kàkwen nde muyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ undiir bun'füün Ayudà, nde kun'sɔɔl isiŋ ntɔn nde usi un'lɔɔn kusà a ba.
